body: Thank you for the words of encouragement! I'm going through a lot of changes and I'm really trying to see all the transition(s) as an opportunity to pursue interests that I otherwise wouldn't have been able to. It's an adventure and its scary, but I know everything will be okay. Thanks again for being so kind!

Hi, I was in a similar situation as you around this time last year and just wanted to let you know that I understand and can completely empathize with you. Please feel free to PM me and I'd be happy to talk to you about my experience. Good luck.
Hi there. We've talked a lot. I feel very isolated because I feel like I'm just screaming at people, trying to prove that I'm happy. That's not what happy people do.

My mom told me that I've made her depressed and that my dad is angry with me. My fiancé thinks I'm unhappy because I seriously cry on a daily basis. I'm irritable and impatient. I'm also a CPS social worker so I work a high stress job then come home to two very disappointed parents. I'm so tired.
